answer.reason: The verses tell of Nathan's message to David about the house, his rebuke of David over Uriah, and his part in anointing Solomon.

clauses.english: told David in the LORD's name that he should not build the LORD a house
clauses.quote: according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

clauses.english: rebuked David with the parable of the ewe lamb, saying "Thou art the man"
clauses.quote: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man.

clauses.english: helped anoint Solomon king over Israel at Gihon
clauses.quote: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon

doubts: ZEC 12:12 names a house of Nathan, probably a different Nathan, so it was left out.
2SA 7:4-5 and 1CH 17:3-4 both give the message to David; only the 2 Samuel verses are cited.
The wording of the first clause depends on verses 2SA 7:5 and 7:6, which were only partly shown; 1CH 17:4 says plainly that David should not build the house.
